origin: Parent-proposed matching-extension lemma, checked against the saved complete matching enumeration. No new numerical experiment.

lemma: If delta(G)>=2k and S is the endpoint union of <=k edges, a size-k matching M exists with S subset of V(M).
lemma_steps: G[S] has an edge cover of size<=k, hence a maximum matching m>=|S|-k.
The r=|S|-2m unmatched vertices satisfy r<=2k-|S|; each has at least2k-|S|+1>r outside-S neighbors, so greedy distinct partners exist.
The resulting matching covers S and has |S|-m<=k edges; while its size l<k, deleting its2l endpoints leaves minimum degree>=2, so it can be padded.
coverage_implication: S subset of V(M) implies R2_G(S) subset of R2_G(V(M)); every size3 matching endpoint set fails by the inherited exhaustive result.
cut_distance_identity: All deleted edges lie inside S, so d_(G-F)(S,t)=d_G(S,t).
subset_spokes_WLOG: Adding spokes to all S is legal because |S|<=6 and every endpoint lost at least one edge; it cannot increase diameter.
all_legal_spokes_covered: Since the source is full6regular, an oldvertex outside S has no freed slot and cannot be adjacent to the hub under maximumdegree6. Thus every legal spoke set is automatically a subset of S.
closed_scope: The fixed120/360 source; delete at most3 old edges, possibly sharing endpoints; add exactly one hub adjacent to all or any subset of the cut endpoints; retain every other old edge and add no other edges.
